hardware: Windows / Ryzen 9 9950X / 128 GiB RAM / RTX 5090 32 GiB
method: MTP off throughout. One 39-token prompt, 64 output tokens, greedy, ctx2048/batch16/threads4. Four warmups plus five timed repeats per fresh engine. Exploratory order 0,16,64; final order 16,0 after partial-tail-block support and matching 2 MiB controller reserve. Each group uses one binary; different groups are separate builds. OS file cache not cleared. Decode tokens/s excludes startup and prefill. Memory values are post-request snapshots; source bytes include prefill and decode. Not a general optimum or a power-consumption measurement.
